name: Cove Beach
role: Lead carpentry subcontractor for West Coast Turn Key
description: A modern glass-and-timber waterfront home set into a rock bluff above the ocean. Renova delivered the mitered cedar rainscreen siding with true waterfall corners and the hemlock waterfall soffits inside and out. At the main entryway, the crew ran the hemlock soffit as one continuous line from the interior ceiling straight through to the exterior overhang with no visible break at the glass — one of the more impressive details of the job.
scope: Mitered cedar siding, hemlock soffit ceilings
